# schemas

- [Anchored][sokf:schema-anchored] - A schema carrying an anchor.
- [Decision Schema][sokf:schema-decision] - One architectural decision.
- [Docs][sokf:schema-docs] - Governs docs with a warning-level rule.
- [Faulty][sokf:schema-faulty] - A schema whose rule refuses its own example.
- [Globs][sokf:schema-globs] - Both dispatches, a bad glob, and a lifecycle beside globs.
- [Issue Schema][sokf:schema-issue] - An issue tracked through its lifecycle.
- [Overview Schema][sokf:schema-overview] - An overview that materializes other documents.
- [Readme Schema][sokf:schema-readme] - The repository readme.
- [Refused][sokf:schema-refused] - A root that is not rooted and a template that admits a non-slug.
- [Requirement Schema][sokf:schema-requirement] - User stories with EARS criteria.
- [Twice][sokf:schema-twice] - A second schema claiming Overview.
